reads_against.argmap: How is parameśvara denoted in āgama-language? → Each āgama-name is an anvartha-projection of pūrṇasaṃvit — denotation is perspectival, referent one.
c1_essence: Parameśvara denoted by āgama-names each anvartha-running from pūrṇasaṃvit: fullness his power, Kālī etc. — let it be in meditators' hearts.
